<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
  <key>Label</key>
  <string>com.sharedmarkethistory.service</string>
  <key>ProgramArguments</key>
  <array>
    <string>__PYTHON__</string>
    <string>-m</string>
    <string>shared_market_history</string>
    <string>--data-root</string>
    <string>__DATA_ROOT__</string>
    <string>serve</string>
  </array>
  <key>WorkingDirectory</key>
  <string>__PROJECT_ROOT__</string>
  <key>EnvironmentVariables</key>
  <dict>
    <key>PYTHONPATH</key>
    <string>__PROJECT_ROOT__/src</string>
    <key>SHARED_HISTORY_BACKFILL_ENABLED</key>
    <string>1</string>
    <key>SHARED_HISTORY_MAINTENANCE_ENABLED</key>
    <string>1</string>
    <key>SHARED_HISTORY_STAGE_TARGETS</key>
    <string>25,75,150,300</string>
    <key>SHARED_HISTORY_STAGE_INTEGRITY</key>
    <string>1</string>
    <key>SHARED_HISTORY_PARQUET_ROOT</key>
    <string>__PARQUET_ROOT__</string>
    <key>SHARED_HISTORY_EXTERNAL_VOLUME_UUID</key>
    <string>__EXTERNAL_VOLUME_UUID__</string>
    <key>PYTHONUNBUFFERED</key>
    <string>1</string>
  </dict>
  <key>RunAtLoad</key>
  <true/>
  <key>KeepAlive</key>
  <true/>
  <key>ThrottleInterval</key>
  <integer>30</integer>
  <!--
    Deliberately no ProcessType=Background. launchd's Background process type
    assigns the Darwin background QoS class, which throttles this writer's file
    I/O along with its CPU. The 1m freshness gate is a latency contract over the
    same Parquet partitions this process rewrites, and the measured full-universe
    pass takes 75.8s at normal QoS versus 220.6s under the background QoS class
    (store time per symbol 0.23s -> 1.92s), which pushes MAX(symbol_1m_lag) past
    the unchanged 300s threshold. Nice is kept so interactive work still wins
    CPU contention.
  -->
  <key>Nice</key>
  <integer>5</integer>
  <key>SoftResourceLimits</key>
  <dict>
    <key>NumberOfFiles</key>
    <integer>4096</integer>
  </dict>
  <key>HardResourceLimits</key>
  <dict>
    <key>NumberOfFiles</key>
    <integer>8192</integer>
  </dict>
  <key>StandardOutPath</key>
  <string>__LOG_ROOT__/service.stdout.log</string>
  <key>StandardErrorPath</key>
  <string>__LOG_ROOT__/service.stderr.log</string>
</dict>
</plist>

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install the standalone Shared Market History service as a per-user launchd job.
set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
PYTHON_BIN="${SHARED_HISTORY_PYTHON:-$PROJECT_ROOT/.venv/bin/python}"
DATA_ROOT="${SHARED_HISTORY_DATA_ROOT:-$HOME/Library/Application Support/SharedMarketHistory}"
PARQUET_ROOT="${SHARED_HISTORY_PARQUET_ROOT:-}"
EXTERNAL_VOLUME_UUID="${SHARED_HISTORY_EXTERNAL_VOLUME_UUID:-}"
LOG_ROOT="$DATA_ROOT/logs"
TEMPLATE="$PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/com.sharedmarkethistory.service.plist"
DEST="$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/com.sharedmarkethistory.service.plist"
LABEL="com.sharedmarkethistory.service"
DOMAIN="gui/$(id -u)"

if [ -x "$PYTHON_BIN" ]; then :; else
  echo "SHARED_HISTORY_PYTHON_MISSING=$PYTHON_BIN" >&2
  exit 2
fi
if [ -n "$PARQUET_ROOT" ] && [ -z "$EXTERNAL_VOLUME_UUID" ]; then
  echo "SHARED_HISTORY_EXTERNAL_VOLUME_UUID_REQUIRED=YES" >&2
  exit 2
fi

mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents" "$LOG_ROOT"

sed -e "s|__PYTHON__|$PYTHON_BIN|g" \
    -e "s|__DATA_ROOT__|$DATA_ROOT|g" \
    -e "s|__PROJECT_ROOT__|$PROJECT_ROOT|g" \
    -e "s|__LOG_ROOT__|$LOG_ROOT|g" \
    -e "s|__PARQUET_ROOT__|$PARQUET_ROOT|g" \
    -e "s|__EXTERNAL_VOLUME_UUID__|$EXTERNAL_VOLUME_UUID|g" \
    "$TEMPLATE" > "$DEST"

launchctl bootout "$DOMAIN/$LABEL" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
launchctl bootstrap "$DOMAIN" "$DEST"
launchctl enable "$DOMAIN/$LABEL"
launchctl kickstart -k "$DOMAIN/$LABEL"

for _ in $(seq 1 240); do
  if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8770/v1/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "SHARED_HISTORY_LAUNCHD_READY=YES"
    echo "URL=http://127.0.0.1:8770"
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 0.5
done

echo "SHARED_HISTORY_LAUNCHD_FAILED=YES" >&2
launchctl print "$DOMAIN/$LABEL" 2>/dev/null | tail -40 >&2 || true
exit 1

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Start ONLY the standalone Shared Market History service.
# This script never starts, stops, or reconfigures Low-Risk or Turbo.
set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
PYTHON_BIN="${SHARED_HISTORY_PYTHON:-$PROJECT_ROOT/.venv/bin/python}"
DATA_ROOT="${SHARED_HISTORY_DATA_ROOT:-$HOME/Library/Application Support/SharedMarketHistory}"
HOST="${SHARED_HISTORY_API_HOST:-127.0.0.1}"
PORT="${SHARED_HISTORY_API_PORT:-8770}"
BACKFILL_ENABLED="${SHARED_HISTORY_BACKFILL_ENABLED:-0}"
PID_FILE="$DATA_ROOT/logs/history-service.pid"
LOG_FILE="$DATA_ROOT/logs/service.log"
URL="http://$HOST:$PORT"

case "$HOST" in
  127.0.0.1|localhost|::1) : ;;
  *)
    echo "REFUSING_NON_LOCALHOST_BIND=$HOST" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac

if [ -x "$PYTHON_BIN" ]; then :; else
  echo "SHARED_HISTORY_PYTHON_MISSING=$PYTHON_BIN" >&2
  exit 2
fi

mkdir -p "$DATA_ROOT/logs"

LABEL="com.sharedmarkethistory.service"
DOMAIN="gui/$(id -u)"
if launchctl print "$DOMAIN/$LABEL" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  launchctl kickstart -k "$DOMAIN/$LABEL" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  for _ in $(seq 1 240); do
    if curl -fsS --max-time 2 "$URL/v1/health" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "SHARED_HISTORY_READY=YES"
      echo "URL=$URL"
      exit 0
    fi
    sleep 0.5
  done
  echo "SHARED_HISTORY_FAILED=YES" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [ -f "$PID_FILE" ]; then
  EXISTING_PID="$(cat "$PID_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [ -n "$EXISTING_PID" ] && kill -0 "$EXISTING_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    if curl -fsS --max-time 3 "$URL/v1/health" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "SHARED_HISTORY_READY=YES"
      echo "URL=$URL"
      exit 0
    fi
    echo "SHARED_HISTORY_PID_EXISTS_BUT_HEALTH_UNAVAILABLE=$EXISTING_PID" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  rm -f "$PID_FILE"
fi

export SHARED_HISTORY_DATA_ROOT="$DATA_ROOT"
export SHARED_HISTORY_API_HOST="$HOST"
export SHARED_HISTORY_API_PORT="$PORT"
export SHARED_HISTORY_BACKFILL_ENABLED="$BACKFILL_ENABLED"

nohup "$PYTHON_BIN" -m shared_market_history --data-root "$DATA_ROOT" serve >>"$LOG_FILE" 2>&1 &
SERVICE_PID=$!
echo "$SERVICE_PID" > "$PID_FILE"

for _ in $(seq 1 240); do
  if curl -fsS --max-time 2 "$URL/v1/health" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "SHARED_HISTORY_READY=YES"
    echo "URL=$URL"
    exit 0
  fi
  if kill -0 "$SERVICE_PID" 2>/dev/null; then :; else
    echo "SHARED_HISTORY_FAILED=YES" >&2
    tail -40 "$LOG_FILE" >&2 || true
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 0.5
done

echo "SHARED_HISTORY_FAILED=YES" >&2
tail -40 "$LOG_FILE" >&2 || true
exit 1

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stop ONLY the standalone Shared Market History service. Low-Risk and Turbo
# are not candidates; the process command line is verified before signalling.
set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
DATA_ROOT="${SHARED_HISTORY_DATA_ROOT:-$HOME/Library/Application Support/SharedMarketHistory}"
PID_FILE="$DATA_ROOT/logs/history-service.pid"

if [ -f "$PID_FILE" ]; then :; else
  echo "SHARED_HISTORY_ALREADY_STOPPED=YES"
  exit 0
fi

LABEL="com.sharedmarkethistory.service"
DOMAIN="gui/$(id -u)"
if launchctl print "$DOMAIN/$LABEL" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  launchctl bootout "$DOMAIN/$LABEL" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  rm -f "$PID_FILE"
  echo "SHARED_HISTORY_STOPPED=YES"
  exit 0
fi

PID="$(cat "$PID_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [ -z "$PID" ]; then
  rm -f "$PID_FILE"
  echo "SHARED_HISTORY_ALREADY_STOPPED=YES"
  exit 0
fi
if kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then :; else
  rm -f "$PID_FILE"
  echo "SHARED_HISTORY_ALREADY_STOPPED=YES"
  exit 0
fi

COMMAND="$(ps -p "$PID" -o command= 2>/dev/null || true)"
case "$COMMAND" in
  *shared_market_history*)
    : ;;
  *)
    echo "REFUSING_TO_KILL_PID=$PID" >&2
    echo "COMMAND=$COMMAND" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

kill -TERM "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
for _ in $(seq 1 40); do
  if kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then :; else
    rm -f "$PID_FILE"
    echo "SHARED_HISTORY_STOPPED=YES"
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 0.25
done

if kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
  kill -KILL "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
rm -f "$PID_FILE"
echo "SHARED_HISTORY_STOPPED=YES"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Remove the per-user launchd job. Low-Risk and Turbo are never addressed.
set -euo pipefail

DEST="$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/com.sharedmarkethistory.service.plist"
LABEL="com.sharedmarkethistory.service"
DOMAIN="gui/$(id -u)"

launchctl bootout "$DOMAIN/$LABEL" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
rm -f "$DEST"
echo "SHARED_HISTORY_LAUNCHD_REMOVED=YES"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Run factual validation backfill (BTC, ETH, factually selected mid-cap and
# lower-liquidity live USDT-SWAP symbols) against the standalone data root.
set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
PYTHON_BIN="${SHARED_HISTORY_PYTHON:-$PROJECT_ROOT/.venv/bin/python}"
DATA_ROOT="${SHARED_HISTORY_DATA_ROOT:-$HOME/Library/Application Support/SharedMarketHistory}"

exec "$PYTHON_BIN" -m shared_market_history --data-root "$DATA_ROOT" backfill \
  --validation-symbols --refresh --funding --open-interest "$@"

[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "shared-market-history"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Standalone shared factual historical market data layer for Low-Risk and Turbo (data only)."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dependencies = ["duckdb>=1.1,<2"]

[project.optional-dependencies]
test = ["pytest>=8,<9"]

[project.scripts]
smh = "shared_market_history.__main__:main"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
pythonpath = ["src"]
testpaths = ["tests"]
addopts = "-q"
filterwarnings = ["ignore::DeprecationWarning"]

      echo "URL=$URL"
      exit 0
    fi
    echo "SHARED_HISTORY_PID_EXISTS_BUT_HEALTH_UNAVAILABLE=$EXISTING_PID" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  rm -f "$PID_FILE"
fi

    echo "URL=$URL"

  fi

tail -40 "$LOG_FILE" >&2 || true

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stop ONLY the standalone Shared Market History service. Low-Risk and Turbo
# are not candidates; the process command line is verified before signalling.
set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
DATA_ROOT="${SHARED_HISTORY_DATA_ROOT:-$HOME/Library/Application Support/SharedMarketHistory}"
PID_FILE="$DATA_ROOT/logs/history-service.pid"

if [ -f "$PID_FILE" ]; then :; else
  echo "SHARED_HISTORY_ALREADY_STOPPED=YES"
  exit 0
fi

LABEL="com.sharedmarkethistory.service"
DOMAIN="gui/$(id -u)"
if launchctl print "$DOMAIN/$LABEL" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  launchctl bootout "$DOMAIN/$LABEL" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  rm -f "$PID_FILE"
  echo "SHARED_HISTORY_STOPPED=YES"
  exit 0
fi

PID="$(cat "$PID_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [ -z "$PID" ]; then
  rm -f "$PID_FILE"
  echo "SHARED_HISTORY_ALREADY_STOPPED=YES"
  exit 0
fi
if kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then :; else
  rm -f "$PID_FILE"
  echo "SHARED_HISTORY_ALREADY_STOPPED=YES"
  exit 0
fi

COMMAND="$(ps -p "$PID" -o command= 2>/dev/null || true)"
case "$COMMAND" in
  *shared_market_history*)
    : ;;
  *)
    echo "REFUSING_TO_KILL_PID=$PID" >&2
    echo "COMMAND=$COMMAND" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

kill -TERM "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
for _ in $(seq 1 40); do
  if kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then :; else
    rm -f "$PID_FILE"
    echo "SHARED_HISTORY_STOPPED=YES"
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 0.25
done

if kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
  kill -KILL "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
rm -f "$PID_FILE"
echo "SHARED_HISTORY_STOPPED=YES"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Remove the per-user launchd job. Low-Risk and Turbo are never addressed.

DOMAIN="gui/$(id -u)"

launchctl bootout "$DOMAIN/$LABEL" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
rm -f "$DEST"
echo "SHARED_HISTORY_LAUNCHD_REMOVED=YES"

[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "shared-market-history"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Standalone shared factual historical market data layer for Low-Risk and Turbo (data only)."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dependencies = ["duckdb>=1.1,<2"]

[project.optional-dependencies]
test = ["pytest>=8,<9"]

[project.scripts]
smh = "shared_market_history.__main__:main"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
pythonpath = ["src"]
testpaths = ["tests"]
addopts = "-q"
filterwarnings = ["ignore::DeprecationWarning"]
